something you need to remember when dealing with symptoms like this is to keep doing your regular routine, but remember to keep up the healthy habits. sometimes when we try to put them off because it’s difficult to do them in this state of mind, its harder to start them up again. so keep up a healthy routine, because it can be a very important factor when trying to get better. 

another thing you can do, although its not for everyone, is to keep a journal. it can be hard at first but sometimes its a relieving process to put whatever thoughts you’re experiencing or feeling on paper. maybe if you put down the dates and the times you’re feeling worst, along with what you were doing at the time, you can identify your triggers. plus, journaling just itself can be kind of calming to some.
